data.subject: PCB filing and a research pilot
data.body:
Hi,

Maltese Capital Management's most recent 13F, for the period ending June 30, 2026, shows positions in FRST and PCB.

On September 24, PCB disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1423869/000142386926000029/pcb-20260923.htm).

I publish a free weekly issue based on public records and can offer a four-week fund pilot.

Andrew
Founder, Local Ledger

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
